ValidationRule.description: Prevents from closing a case when status is "OnHold customer"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ((ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "On Hold - Customer")),ISPICKVAL( Status, "Closed"), AND (OR( (ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Country__c,'Argentina')) , (ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Country__c,'Brazil')) , (ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Country__c,'Peru')) ,(ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Country__c,'Chile')) , (ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Country__c,'Mexico')), (ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Country__c,'Colombia')) )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can not close a case from status "On Hold - Customer".
